title: Decisions and next review
summary: Use Edit to record a choice, date and acceptance note. Confirmed technical targets are recorded below; open proposals remain review items.

items.title: Confirmed / environment first
items.body: 12 November 2026 — Owner: focus on the Basement and environment art. Work only in the four named maps. Defer characters, weapons, UI and unrelated levels.

items.title: Confirmed / density and target PC
items.body: 12 November 2026 — Owner: densities are pixels per meter. Target RTX 2060 + Ryzen 5 5600, 1080p, medium-high, approximately 60 FPS. Starting density references: 256 px/m on some modular structures; 512 px/m on simple props. Actual performance has not been measured.

items.title: Review / the first Basement pass
items.body:
**Proposal:** first inspect the assembled corridor/shop lighting and module fit, then strengthen the 1970s service-area identity with a small, coherent art pass. Preserve the neglected dungeon-like atmosphere.

Owner choice / date: pending.

Accepted visual examples: pending. The current corridor is a baseline, not automatic approval of every current surface or light.

items.title: Pending / modular kit contract
items.body:
Measure the existing module sizes, snap grid, pivot convention and export/import scale. Test one copied wall/floor/corner assembly before standardizing. Do not infer a one-meter or four-meter grid from scene units alone.

Grid and dimensions: pending evidence.
Export/import settings: pending round-trip trial.

items.title: Inspect / three missing source images
items.body: `Bars_basecolor.png`, `Chains_basecolor.png` and `Old_Elevator_Door_basecolor.png` are missing from their Blender paths. Matching `.sbs` sources and the elevator atlas exist. Check active usage before regenerating or relinking. No fix has been applied.

items.title: Later / window ownership
items.body: Owner raised moving windows from the prop file into the modular structure file. Keep as a future library decision; no asset migration has been performed.

items.title: Optional / Designer graph connection
items.body: The existing Adobe batch tools work. An in-app read-only Python audit is prepared. Run it when interactive graph inspection or editing is the next concrete task. No additional Designer MCP or runtime Unreal Substance plugin was installed.
